cues.en: So in the last lecture, we defined all these properties, now let's put them into our shorthand here.

cues.en: Well actually, the position comes first and then is separated from the size with a slash.

cues.en: So what you can do is you can write left 10%, bottom 20%, just as we have it here and then
cues.zh: 所以你可以寫 left 10%、bottom 20%，就像這裡一樣，然後

cues.en: slash, forward slash and then your size values,
